svg.text: PROJECT: LumiGap - An Intelligent Research Gap Discovery and Academic Collaboration Platform
NOTATION: CHEN ERD CONCEPTUAL VIEW OF ERD 1.2 (no attributes, keys or join tables) SOURCE: Prisma schema + SQL migrations, main 019749f (39 strong + 2 weak entities, 8 domains)
Cardinality (red, next to each entity): 1:1, 1:N, N:M. N:M diamonds name the join table in [brackets]; their attributes hang off the diamond.
